evidence.excerpt: Grujić is fully active and has no planned sabbatical. She prefers partnerships where the company can share even a small number of labelled anomaly examples, as her methods rely on partial supervision. She is not interested in purely unsupervised or image-based projects. Response time to collaboration enquiries is typically within one week.
